blocks.prompt: 11 If \(a, b, c, d\) are in H.P., show that \(3(a - b)(c - d) = (b - c)(a - d)\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh proof chaar H.P. terms ke baare mein hai. Seedha \(a, b, c, d\) ke saath kaam karna mushkil hai, is liye hum reciprocals ki A.P. ka sahara lenge.
A.P. ki pehli term ko \(p\) aur common difference ko \(q\) kahenge; phir har letter \(p\) aur \(q\) mein likha ja sakta hai.
Plan: \(a - b\), \(c - d\), \(b - c\), \(a - d\) ko \(p, q\) mein likho, phir dono sides ka hisaab lagao.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(a, b, c, d\) H.P. mein hain.
Saabit karna hai: \(3(a - b)(c - d) = (b - c)(a - d)\).
Tareeqa: \(\frac{1}{a}, \frac{1}{b}, \frac{1}{c}, \frac{1}{d}\) A.P. mein hain, is liye
\[\dfrac{1}{a} = p, \; \dfrac{1}{b} = p + q\]
\[\dfrac{1}{c} = p + 2q, \; \dfrac{1}{d} = p + 3q\]
(koi bhi zero nahi). Yani \(a = \frac{1}{p}\), \(b = \frac{1}{p + q}\), wagaira.

Ek farq nikalein
\[a - b = \dfrac{1}{p} - \dfrac{1}{p + q}\]
\[= \dfrac{q}{p(p + q)}\]
Kyun: Common denominator lene par upar \((p + q) - p = q\) bachta hai. Dekhiye, H.P. ki do terms ka farq hamesha "reciprocals ka farq" upar aur "reciprocals ka product" neeche hota hai.

Baqi teen farq
\[c - d = \dfrac{q}{(p + 2q)(p + 3q)}\]
\[b - c = \dfrac{q}{(p + q)(p + 2q)}\]
\[a - d = \dfrac{3q}{p(p + 3q)}\]
Kyun: Wahi tareeqa. \(a\) aur \(d\) ke reciprocals mein teen qadam ka farq hai, \((p + 3q) - p = 3q\), is liye upar \(3q\) aaya.
Dhyan dein: \(a - d\) mein upar \(q\) likh dena aam ghalti hai; yahan 3 qadam hain.

Left hand side (L.H.S.)
\[3(a - b)(c - d)\]
\[= \dfrac{3q \cdot q}{p(p + q)(p + 2q)(p + 3q)}\]
\[= \dfrac{3q^{2}}{p(p + q)(p + 2q)(p + 3q)}\]
Kyun: Do fractions ko multiply kiya: upar upar se, neeche neeche se. 3 bahar tha woh upar chala gaya.

Right hand side (R.H.S.)
\[(b - c)(a - d)\]
\[= \dfrac{q \cdot 3q}{(p + q)(p + 2q) \cdot p(p + 3q)}\]
\[= \dfrac{3q^{2}}{p(p + q)(p + 2q)(p + 3q)}\]
Kyun: Neeche wahi chaar factors \(p, p + q, p + 2q, p + 3q\) hain, sirf tarteeb alag; aur upar bhi \(3q^{2}\).

Nateeja
\[3(a - b)(c - d) = (b - c)(a - d)\]
Kyun: Dono sides ek hi expression ke barabar nikli, is liye aapas mein barabar hain.

Tasdeeq numbers se: \(a = 1, b = \frac{1}{2}, c = \frac{1}{3}, d = \frac{1}{4}\) (reciprocals 1, 2, 3, 4 A.P. hain).
\[3 \cdot \dfrac{1}{2} \cdot \dfrac{1}{12} = \dfrac{1}{8}\]
\[\dfrac{1}{6} \cdot \dfrac{3}{4} = \dfrac{1}{8} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(a - b = \frac{1}{2}\), \(c - d = \frac{1}{12}\), \(b - c = \frac{1}{6}\), \(a - d = \frac{3}{4}\). Dono taraf \(\frac{1}{8}\), to formula sahi hai.
blocks.final_answer: Saabit ho gaya: \(3(a - b)(c - d) = (b - c)(a - d)\).
